title: A merchant captured 160.00 against a 100.00 authorization
details:
Risk flagged this during the weekly chargeback review.

Authorization auth_004182 held USD 100.00. The merchant captured 80.00 on Tuesday, shipped the rest of
the order on Thursday, and captured 80.00 again — and we accepted it. The card network did not, and the
80.00 second capture came back as a chargeback with a fee attached.

Looking through the last month there are eleven authorizations where the sum of the captures is more
than the amount that was held. In every one of them each individual capture was smaller than the
authorization; it is the total that is over.

A single capture larger than the hold IS refused correctly — we tested that. It is only when a merchant
captures in parts that the total is allowed to run past the amount authorised.

The hold is the ceiling for everything captured against it, not for each capture separately.
